comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling to first-time and move-up buyers with affiliated mortgage and title services, closely matching KB Home.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Large production homebuilder selling to entry-level and move-up buyers with mortgage and title arms; rental business is secondary.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Production homebuilder for first-time and move-up buyers with affiliated mortgage and title services, same model.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Sells finished lots to homebuilders as a B2B land developer; it does not build or sell homes to buyers.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes with affiliated mortgage and title services; its land development largely supports its own building.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Production homebuilder selling homes to first-time and move-up buyers with in-house mortgage and title services, though it uses an option-based lot model.
